description: PT-141 (bremelanotide) is a cyclic heptapeptide analogue of α-melanocyte-stimulating hormone. It is used in receptor-pharmacology research as a melanocortin receptor agonist with a different selectivity profile from the linear analogue Melanotan I, which is why the two are commonly compared in structure–activity studies of the α-MSH series.

faq.question: What is PT-141?
faq.answer: PT-141 (bremelanotide) is a cyclic melanocortin receptor agonist peptide, CAS 189691-06-3, supplied as a laboratory research reagent.

faq.question: How does PT-141 differ from Melanotan II?
faq.answer: Both are cyclic melanocortin agonists studied in the same receptor family; they differ in sequence and in their reported receptor-subtype selectivity profiles, which is why comparative receptor studies use them as separate tools.
